question: Who among the following has been appointed as the Force Commander of UN mission in South Sudan in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shailesh Tinaikar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shailesh Tinaikar** was appointed as the Force Commander of the UN mission in South Sudan in 2019.
 
• He succeeded Lieutenant General Frank Mushyo Kamanzi of Rwanda.
 
• Shailesh Tinaikar
